hero.title: Which Xfinity Internet plan should you pick?
hero.subtitle: Match your household to the right speed in seconds. Find the row that sounds like you and see exactly which plan we recommend and why.
matrix.title: Match your situation to the right plan
row-1.situation: One or two people, mostly browsing and HD streaming
row-1.why: Plenty of speed for everyday streaming and working from home at our best starter price.
row-2.situation: A busy family with lots of devices online at once
row-2.why: Fast, consistent speed that keeps every phone, TV, and laptop smooth at peak hours.
row-3.situation: Serious gaming, 4K streaming, and big downloads
row-3.why: Gig-speed headroom handles heavy gaming and 4K across dozens of devices with no slowdowns.
row-4.situation: Working from home with video calls all day
row-4.why: Reliable upload and download speed keeps video calls crisp while others stream nearby.
row-5.situation: You want the fastest, most future-proof plan
row-5.why: Our fastest home plan with a 5-year price guarantee, so you are set for years to come.
options.title: A closer look at each option
item-1.name: Xfinity Internet 300 Mbps
item-1.body: Simple, seamless WiFi with 99.9% reliability for everyday work and play, plus same-day self-install and a free mobile line for a year.
item-2.name: Xfinity Internet 500 Mbps
item-2.body: Fast, consistent WiFi that keeps up with all your devices at once, with a free Xfinity Mobile line and no annual contract.
item-3.name: Xfinity Gig Internet
item-3.body: Fiber-powered Gig WiFi for always-online homes: gigabit speeds, unlimited data, and the xFi Gateway included for 4K streaming and gaming.
guide.title: Still deciding? A few quick tips
guide.items: Count your devices: 10 or more streaming at once points to 500 Mbps or Gig.
Gamers and 4K streamers should size up to Gig for headroom during peak hours.
Every plan includes unlimited data, the xFi Gateway, and a 5-year price guarantee.
You can start smaller and upgrade later with no annual contract holding you back.
cta.title: Found your match?
cta.body: Pick the plan that fits your home, self-install in minutes, and add a free Xfinity Mobile line for a year.
